near_miss_chains.description: A non-production resource (staging, dev, test, qa, sandbox, demo) is dormant AND publicly reachable. The compound is the canonical NHI-offboarding failure mode: forgotten ephemeral infrastructure retained on the internet, beyond active maintenance, accumulating configuration drift. Stave's per-service public-access controls fire on each individual exposure dimension (S3 bucket policy, EC2 SG ingress, API Gateway resource policy, ALB topology); the staleness control fires on the lifecycle-plus-environment-tag combination. Either alone is a finding; both on the same asset is the shadow-infrastructure crisis the writeups in channels/devto/ describe.
